scale_measurement.method: Manual pixel-coordinate estimate on original; about ±2 px. No person in original, so face ratio is not applicable.

visual_qa.coal_count: Not visually observable under closed lid; prompt specifies two inside.

game_preview.method: Playwright routes candidate PNG only in an isolated context; real vn.play with previewProtagonist and existing portrait/UI assets. Preview dialogue is not game dialogue.
game_preview.manual_review: Cake stays above dialogue band in 1/2-character views. Meteor and telescope remain visible; central characters readable. Two-character birthday view naturally occludes left-side hookah.
game_preview.night_tint_test: No independent extra night tint overlay was forced; verify the final chapter atmosphere on adoption.
